div.p: Bernice McPherson, Di Christensen and Craig Perry Steel seat 1995 Corner of Buncle and Catyre Streets, North Melbourne (Melway ref. 2A E5)
This curved, painted metal seating is sited at the gateway into Hotham Estate. Three photo-etched stainless-steel panels feature stylised birds and form part of the seat's back.
